BiblicalUsage: Henotes means oneness, unity, and Paul uses it twice, both times for the church. In Ephesians 4:3 the church is to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace, and in Ephesians 4:13 we are to come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe unity is not something I make, it is something I keep: the Spirit made it, and my job is to guard it in peace until we all arrive at it together.
